rubricPolicyReason: Maximum 10 and passing threshold 8 give 80% and slack 2. minimalCompletenessFindings: All 39 submissions were graded in order: 16 pass and 23 fail solely at 8/10. A compact exact numerical quotient with N and correct direction earns 10; separate intermediate lines and decimal evaluation are unnecessary. Assigned numerical operands used in the quotient also count. Missing numerical momentum application, applied duration or physical direction keeps otherwise correct work at most 7.5. Qualitative-only work scores 3 and general-formula-only work 1. Unsupported constant or particular instantaneous-force assertions reduce otherwise complete work to 7.5; omitting that optional discussion costs nothing. Isolated arithmetic or unit slips remain compatible with passing.
